title: Kirik Party
desc: Karna, a first-year engineering student, falls in love with Saanvi, a final-year pupil from his college. However, a tragic event changes his perception towards life and he mends his ways.

title: Grama Devathe
desc: Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.

title: Kotigobba 3
desc: After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.
